headline: Gold eases ₹76 per gram today; silver flat at ₹1,90,000 per kg
summary: Today's 24k gold moved down ₹76 per gram (about 0.56%) from yesterday, a small dip. Over the last 7 days gold has fallen about 4.66%, and silver has dropped about 7.32% to ₹1,90,000 per kg, with silver unchanged today. The 23-day history shows 24k gold peaking at ₹14,602 on 5 November and silver at ₹2,20,000 per kg on 26 October, so the recent slide has been steady; possible drivers include a firmer US dollar, a stronger rupee, or softer festive and wedding buying, though these are only possibilities.
outlook: Prices are lower than they have been for much of the past three weeks, so if you are buying for an upcoming occasion, comparing jewellers' making charges and GST matters more than waiting for a small daily move.
